toegepas.voor: Die meeste van die land is
toegepas.na: Die grootste deel van die land is
toegepas.rede_vinder: 'Die meeste van die land' follows English 'most of the country'; 'die grootste deel' is the idiomatic Afrikaans for a portion of one area.
toegepas.fout: 'Die meeste van die land' copies English 'most of the country' for a portion of one area.
toegepas.rede_keurder: 'Die grootste deel van die land' is the idiomatic Afrikaans and keeps the same quantity, so the meaning is unchanged.

toegepas.na: In hierdie strook het nedersettings gegroei:
toegepas.rede_vinder: 'Daar' follows a sentence about the desert, so it can be read as pointing to the desert instead of the strip along the river.
toegepas.fout: 'Daar' follows a sentence about the desert, so a reader can take it to mean the settlements grew in the desert.
toegepas.rede_keurder: 'In hierdie strook' points unambiguously back to the strip along the Nile, which is what the original meant.

toegepas.rede_vinder: 'Daardie' is stiff and distancing for boats just mentioned; the plain article reads more naturally.
toegepas.fout: 'Daardie' is stiff and distancing for boats named in the sentence just before.
toegepas.rede_keurder: The plain article reads naturally and refers to the same boats, so nothing moves.

toegepas.voor: 'n groot en georganiseerde samelewing met landbou en handel en ook 'n regering en godsdiens
toegepas.na: 'n groot, georganiseerde samelewing met landbou, handel, 'n regering en godsdiens
toegepas.rede_vinder: The chain of 'en ... en ook ... en' is clumsy; a plain list reads better and matches the glossary definition of beskawing word for word.
toegepas.fout: The chain 'groot en georganiseerde ... landbou en handel en ook 'n regering en godsdiens' is clumsy.
toegepas.rede_keurder: A plain list with the same four items reads better, loses nothing, and matches the shared glossary definition of beskawing.

laat_vaar.blok: Die Nyl het elke jaar oorstroom
laat_vaar.voor: Die Aswan-hoogdam beheer sedert 1970 die rivier.
laat_vaar.na: Sedert 1970 beheer die Aswan-hoogdam die rivier.
laat_vaar.rede_vinder: Putting the time phrase first reads more naturally and links better to the next sentence starting with 'Vandag'.
laat_vaar.rede_keurder: The original word order is natural Afrikaans; moving the time phrase first is a lateral move.

laat_vaar.na: en die land rondom die rivier bedek
laat_vaar.rede_vinder: 'Rondom' left without an object reads as incomplete; naming the river makes the definition clear when read on its own.
laat_vaar.rede_keurder: This is a glossary definition and 'die land rondom' is acceptable Afrikaans that is clear on its own, so there is no error a language agent may fix.
